Access the ICES dataset of stock assessment results

Source: R/FLStockpile-package.R
FLStockpile-package.Rd

The dataset holds the stock assessment results submitted to ICES, as four parquet tables. Each stock assessment, a stock code and an assessment year, has one or more versions: a corrected submission becomes a new version, and earlier versions are kept.

Details

stocks

one row per version, see stockpile_stocks()

sources

the submitted objects each version was made from, see stockpile_sources()

values

the observed data and model estimates, see stockpile_values()

indices

the survey indices, see stockpile_indices()

The location of the tables is set with stockpile_url().
